blockers.requirement: Acceptable, scientifically supported Q/R estimates under R21 Option A.
blockers.existing_evidence: Nine starts, likelihood profile and leave-one-cycle-out fits all press to both approved upper bounds; synthetic diagnostics do not establish historical identifiability.
blockers.missing_evidence: A valid interior estimate or independently justified approved covariance values with uncertainty; owner decision on model/estimation revision.
blockers.scientific_consequence: Current Q/R candidate is not an accepted production configuration.
blockers.required_resolution: Owner-approved revised R21 approach or externally supported physical Q/R values; do not silently widen bounds or apply the boundary fit.

blockers.requirement: Apply training-only R21 scales and P0 to held-out cycles.
blockers.existing_evidence: Option A approves normalized P0=diag(1,1/36) and per-sequence scale normalization.
blockers.missing_evidence: Frozen mapping from cycles 1-12 training scales to physical Q/R/P0 for cycles 13-25.
blockers.scientific_consequence: No defensible held-out covariance initialization can be constructed without using held-out observations or inventing a mapping.
blockers.required_resolution: Owner-approved, training-only scale application rule with evidence references.

blockers.requirement: Define the training residual chronology used by the R21 likelihood.
blockers.existing_evidence: The cycles 4-5 residual sequences use the R20-selected w=0.50,tau=12 configuration, selected on cycles 6-12; all remain within the cycles 1-12 R21 training partition.
blockers.missing_evidence: Explicit ruling whether this is acceptable for R21 training likelihoods or whether every training-cycle residual must use only configuration information available before that cycle.
blockers.scientific_consequence: The strict causal interpretation of the cycles 4-5 residuals is unresolved, although no cycles 13-24 were used.
blockers.required_resolution: Specify the intended prequential/cross-fitted training residual procedure before any revised R21 fit.

blockers.requirement: Freeze A2 ensemble size and deterministic seed policy.
blockers.existing_evidence: Draft 1.7 lists sizes 100, 250, 500 and seeds 0-4 as candidates and gives diagnostic criteria.
blockers.missing_evidence: No verified candidate results or selected configuration; the exact deterministic tie-break is not frozen.
blockers.scientific_consequence: A2 production settings cannot be selected without either valid R22 results and an approved decision rule or owner approval.
blockers.required_resolution: Resolve R21 first, then execute candidates on cycles 6-12 and freeze a deterministic selection/tie-break rule.

blockers.requirement: Freeze cycle detector, DTW, and local peak/matching settings.
blockers.existing_evidence: Draft 1.7 contains candidate grids for R23-R25; repository search found no verified selected outputs.
blockers.missing_evidence: Candidate result records, deterministic objectives/tie-breaks, and selected settings for cycles 6-12.
blockers.scientific_consequence: Required diagnostics cannot be reported as using selected, frozen settings.
blockers.required_resolution: Execute authorized training-only candidate diagnostics where independent, and obtain owner-approved selection rules where the protocol does not specify a unique winner.

blockers.requirement: Generate protocol-defined calibration intervals and evidence status.
blockers.existing_evidence: A0 Type-8 absolute-error diagnostics exist for cycles 13-15; existing outputs used symmetric error bounds as an implementation interpretation.
blockers.missing_evidence: Frozen interval-bound construction and independent-cycle sufficiency decision.
blockers.scientific_consequence: Existing A0 interval output is evidence-limited and not protocol-certified; no coverage guarantee is established.
blockers.required_resolution: Freeze the interval construction and retain UNRESOLVED_CALIBRATION_EVIDENCE when independent cycle evidence is insufficient.

blockers.requirement: Generate the authorized Cycle 25 exploratory forecast.
blockers.existing_evidence: R29/R30 authorize a Cycle 25 exploratory forecast; the current dataset has 79 non-provisional and 3 provisional records.
blockers.missing_evidence: Frozen forecast origin, target horizon, and provisional-suffix handling for Cycle 25.
blockers.scientific_consequence: No unique forecast can be produced without choosing an unapproved origin/horizon or using provisional observations contrary to the approved policy.
blockers.required_resolution: Owner approval of origin, horizon and provisional observation treatment.

blockers.requirement: Evaluate A1 and A2 independently against A0 under the four R32 conditions.
blockers.existing_evidence: R32 evaluator and synthetic tests are implemented; V3 pytest suite passes.
blockers.missing_evidence: Protocol-compliant, identical-origin A1/A2 forecasts and final evaluation rows.
blockers.scientific_consequence: R32 is NOT_EVALUABLE for historical candidates; scientific acceptance is not granted.
blockers.required_resolution: Resolve covariance/configuration gates, execute matched cycles 16-24 forecasts, then run R32 independently for A1 and A2.

blockers.requirement: Authorize exact scopes under the revised production protocol.
blockers.existing_evidence: R30 gate is CLEARED for the exact Draft 1.7 scope set.
blockers.missing_evidence: Owner authorization for a future protocol revision and its exact configuration/execution scopes.
blockers.scientific_consequence: Draft 1.7 authorization cannot be treated as automatic authorization for a materially revised protocol.
blockers.required_resolution: Obtain explicit owner approval and exact-scope authorization after the revised protocol is complete.
